vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: news-scout
Version: 1.0.3

The news-scout skill bundle is a legitimate news aggregation tool designed to fetch and analyze AI and investment news. The Python script (scripts/scout.py) uses standard libraries like feedparser and duckduckgo-search to collect data from a well-defined list of RSS feeds and search queries in resources/news_sources.json. The instructions in SKILL.md are clearly aligned with the stated purpose, providing a structured workflow for the AI agent without any signs of prompt injection or malicious intent. No evidence of data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, or obfuscation was found.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and news-source configuration match its stated purpose (aggregating AI and investing news) and do not request unrelated credentials or privileged access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, scripts/scout.py and resources/news_sources.json are consistent: the skill fetches RSS feeds and DuckDuckGo search results to produce AI and investing news summaries. Required capabilities (network access, optional proxy) align with the stated purpose; there are no unexpected credentials or unrelated system accesses.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the included script (or falling back to built-in web_search/web_fetch) and formatting results into a fixed 10-item markdown summary. The runtime instructions only reference the script, the resources/news_sources.json file, and common proxy environment variables (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY). There are no directives to read unrelated user files, secrets, or send data to external endpoints beyond fetching public RSS/search results.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is included (instruction-only), and the repository includes a Python script and a JSON resource file. SKILL.md recommends installing common Python packages (feedparser, duckduckgo-search, requests) which is proportionate to the task. No arbitrary binary downloads or remote installers are used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no declared credentials or config paths. The script reads standard proxy environment variables (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) to support network routing — this is reasonable for a networked fetcher. No other environment secrets or unrelated tokens are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request persistent system-wide configuration changes. It does not modify other skills or agent settings. Autonomous invocation (disable-model-invocation = false) is the platform default and expected for a user-invocable skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements what it says: it fetches public RSS feeds and DDG search results and formats summaries. Before installing, review resources/news_sources.json to ensure you’re comfortable with the listed feeds, run the script in an isolated environment if you want to observe its network calls, and install dependencies in a virtualenv. Be aware the skill performs network requests (including to paywalled sources listed) and honors HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY — configure proxies if required. If you need stronger assurance, inspect the included scripts locally (scripts/scout.py) and test with a limited feed list. If you operate in a restricted environment, ensure network egress policies permit the necessary HTTP(S) calls.
